SPLITTER_PLUGIN Body

Package to maintain a splitter oriented APEX page.

This package implements the splitter plugin as provided by APEX in the page designer, but enhanced and without the requirement to grant access to an APEX internal package.

I just extracted the render and ajax method into this package and adopted it to my coding style (optically).

Author
